SELECT c.id, c.activity_id as activityId, c.user_id as userId, c.checkin_time as checkinTime, c.checkout_time as checkoutTime, c.checkin_location as checkinLocation, c.checkout_location as checkoutLocation, c.actual_service_hours as serviceHours, c.status, c.remark, c.created_time as createdTime, c.updated_time as updatedTime, a.title as activityTitle, a.start_time as activityStartTime, a.end_time as activityEndTime, vu.real_name as userName, vu.phone as userPhone FROM activity_checkin c LEFT JOIN activity a ON c.activity_id = a.id LEFT JOIN volunteer_user vu ON c.user_id = vu.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted = 0
AND a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{activityTitle}, '%')
ORDER BY c.checkin_time DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(actual_service_hours), 0) FROM activity_checkin WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND actual_service_hours IS NOT NULL AND actual_service_hours > 0
